A dashboard can embed datasources that name a project secret, and its saved proxy route only checks datasource read. A solver can dismiss it because dashboards have their own permissions and the report is about datasources. Next to it, users with only datasource read must still query saved datasources through the proxy, so a fix that checks secret read on every proxy request breaks normal use.
